text:
mariam: FYI rolled FP8 enable across h100 pool yesterday night and we're seeing a spike in p99 latency (~12%) and a few user-facing tail errors. looks correlated with bursts of KV cache evictions

alex: same here on a subset of L40S hosts — saw p50 stable but p99 jumps. suspect kernel selection is oscillating between fp8 and int8 slowpath when batch size & seq len vary.

mariam: approving logs: 
``` 
[2024-04-05 02:12:03] request_id=ri_... model=redwood-3b-fp8 kernel=fp8_fast latency=28ms
[2024-04-05 02:12:03] request_id=ri_... model=redwood-3b-fp8 kernel=int8_slow latency=180ms fallback_reason=quant_offload
[2024-04-05 02:12:05] kv_cache: evict shard=7 keys=132 drop_reason=memory_pressure
```
noticed a lot of short-lived clip/summary requests with seq len 8-12, microbatched to 4-6. maybe KV thrash.

raj: can repro locally by replaying the small-chat trace. try this microbench: 
``` 
./perf_client --model redwood-3b --seq 12 --microbatch 6 --concurrency 32 --quant fp8
```
that toggles the kernel chooser in ~5s for me. also check `quant_kernel_score_threshold` in runtime conf — low threshold lets fp8 try when unstable.

sasha: +1 on KV churn. our eviction heuristic currently checks free_mem < threshold then evicts aggressively. for tiny seq workloads the KV hitrate collapses and we keep thrashing. patch idea: skip eviction for cached keys younger than 30s if hit_rate > 0.7. this reduces churn without adding memory pressure on steady workloads.

yuan: i profiled a host with nvtx markers. big signal is memcpy + kernel launch overhead for int8_slow fallback. sample: 
``` 
KernelSummary:
  fp8_fast   time=34.2ms calls=120  avg=0.285ms
  int8_slow  time=510.6ms calls=12  avg=42.55ms  memcpy=120ms
HostMemcpy:  total=134ms
```
so once one request hits the slowpath, microbatching pulls more requests into the same batch and amplifies tail.

mariam: interesting — so oscillation + KV eviction + slowpath memcpy spiral. we should mitigate at a few layers: kernel selection hysteresis, batching cap for suspected fallback, and softer KV eviction.

alex: transformer-engine flags matter too. on L40S we saw enabling `--te-quant-allow-noncontig` made fp8 kernels pick a slower codepath for some layouts. current canary had that enabled. i can flip it off in canary and re-run.

raj: also calibration: some of our per-tensor calibration runs produced too-aggressive scales for attention proj which causes small-magnitude weights to underflow -> NaNs occasionally -> kernel chooser bails and uses int8 slowpath. add a sanity clamp to calibration: scale = max(scale, min_scale) and re-run calib.

perf-bot: anomaly detected: eng-runtime/h100-pool p99 latency +12.3% (1h window) — suspected tags: fp8, kernel_fallback, kv_eviction. Alert id: pb-20240405-1242

mariam: action items:
- alex: rollback `--te-quant-allow-noncontig` on canary L40S and report.
- sasha: prototype KV eviction skip rule (young keys + hitrate) and add metric kv_eviction_skipped.
- raj: add calib clamp and re-calibrate model bundle for redwood-3b-fp8, push candidate to canary.
- yuan: run nvprof trace on one h100 host during canary and capture memcpy/kernel breakdown.
- ops: keep traffic routing to avoid full fleet rollout until canary stable.

alex: starting rollback now on canary L40S. will post results in ~10m :thumbsup:

sasha: patch pushed to feature branch, creating a small A/B to compare eviction counts and hitrate.

raj: pushed calib-clamp branch, running calib job in staging — ETA 45m.

yuan: collecting nvprof - will attach condensed trace after capture. initial looks better when avoiding memcpy-heavy slowpath.

mariam: thanks team. if canary clears in 1h we can re-enable with tuned hysteresis and KV changes. otherwise rollback FP8 rollout and mark as incident.

alex: can confirm after rollback on canary L40S p99 dropped back ~10% within 5m. looks promising.

perf-bot: update: canary h100 p99 latency delta -9.8% after changes (30m window) — monitoring continues.

mariam: great. we'll keep this thread as the canonical notes for follow-ups (metrics to add: kernel_switch_rate, kv_eviction_skipped, calib_clamp_applied, slowpath_memcpy_ms).
